caption_L1: This bar chart is called Gross value added (GVA) of the food and drink manufacturing sector in the United Kingdom (UK) in 2018 , by product type (in billion GBP). The x-axis shows product type along categorical scale with Bakery on one end and Prepared animal feeds at the other while the y-axis measures Gross value added in billion GBP using linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 8.
caption_L2L3: The product with the highest GVA is beverages which is followed by other food products. There is then a larger difference before the third highest product which is meats and meat products. The product with the lowest GVA is oils and fats with fish and crustaceans slightly higher.
